title: Structured Identity Milestone 2A paired diagnostic decomposition
note: No-retraining decomposition of the persisted five-session Milestone 2A OOF predictions and grouped nulls. This records diagnostic geometry, not authorization for M2 or M3.

claims.statement: The diagnostic contains 15 paired session-area cells. R1 G_balanced is negative in 9/15 cells, R0 G_balanced is negative in 6/15 cells, and Delta_temporal = G_R1 - G_R0 is negative in 11/15 cells. The unweighted cell means are G_R0=0.040157, G_R1=-0.068613, and Delta_temporal=-0.108770.

The all-area leave-one-session-out summaries retain negative G_R1 and negative paired Delta_temporal for all five held-out sessions. This supports sensitivity of the descriptive direction to session omission, while not establishing a biological population effect.

The presented-identity positive-control summary contains 30 session-area-representation cells. Presented balanced accuracy ranges from 0.388104 to 1.000000, and 18/30 cells have grouped-null two-sided p<0.05. Control adequacy is therefore heterogeneous and must remain visible in interpretation.
The review provides a secondary continuous signed-evidence diagnostic from the persisted ridge decision_score. It is explicitly not a calibrated probability and does not replace G_balanced.

issues: The primary reversal test holds the held-out position fixed at p4; position is not independently decomposable in this artifact.
Cells and folds are nested within five sessions and three subjects; cell counts are descriptive rather than independent biological replicates.
Positive-control strength varies by session and area; a passed extraction/model gate is not equivalent to uniformly strong identity decoding.
No calibrated probabilities were persisted; continuous decision scores are only a secondary signed-evidence diagnostic.
SAFE_TO_TRAIN_M2_M3 remains NO pending Sol/Hamm review of this decomposition.

verification.verdict: diagnostic_complete; descriptive R1 direction is not uniform at cell level but paired temporal deltas are predominantly negative; keep M2/M3 gate closed pending review

falsifier: This diagnostic node is superseded if the persisted Milestone 2A input hashes change, if a corrected OOF/null artifact invalidates the paired quantities, or if a versioned review replaces this decomposition.
